Status rule: claimed_only = only a party to the conflict says it; third_party_report = one independent source; confirmed = more than one. JMIC counts as a second source only when it adds information beyond relaying UKMTO; a non-party government counts as independent. No Bab el-Mandeb incidents in the window.

rows.place: About 13 nm north of Khasab, Oman
rows.summary: Outbound product tanker (named NAVIG8 MESSI by India's Minister of Ports) struck by an unknown projectile; fire later extinguished, vessel under tow.
